title: US request for Quiboloy extradition filed before Makati court -DOJ

blocks.text: The request of the United States Government for the extradition of Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) founder Apollo Quiboloy has been filed before the Makati Regional Trial Court (RTC), the Department of Justice (DOJ) said Tuesday.
According to the DOJ, the petition was filed on November 9, 2026, and was raffled to Makati RTC Branch 145. Aside from Quiboloy, the extradition request also covers Teresita Dandan and Helen Panilag.
The US government earlier requested the Philippines to extradite Quiboloy over sex trafficking and racketeering charges he faces in the United States.
In early October, the DOJ confirmed that the preparation of its extradition petition was in its final stages. –NB, GMA News
